It has greyish-green skin with prominent granular scales and a distinct dorsal crest running down its neck and back. A large dewlap hangs from its throat. The front left limb is gripping the wood, showing long digits with claws. The background appears to be a rocky enclosure, possibly behind glass given the slight reflection/glare on the right side.
